answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments bind each agent's identity to a cryptographic anchor that aggregates prior attestations into a succinct proof, while a verifiable delay function instantiated as a sequential mesa of hash-chained evaluations forces any Sybil attacker to expend provable time-cost proportional to stake-weighted difficulty, with staking collateral locked and slashing penalties automatically liquidating a fraction of the deposit on equivocation.
